description: This file contains implementation code for container management within the WPEFramework, including classes and methods for container lifecycle operations such as creation, starting, stopping, and status querying, as well as singleton access patterns and logging initialization.

classes.name: IContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Interface for container administrator singleton access.

classes.name: CRunContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Implementation of container administrator managing container instances.

classes.name: CRunContainer
classes.description: Represents a container instance with lifecycle management methods such as Start, Stop, and status checks.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Provides singleton instance of the container administrator.

methods.name: Container
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a container based on configuration files found in search paths.

methods.name: Logging
methods.description: Configures logging for container scope (stub implementation).

methods.name: CRunContainer
methods.description: Constructor initializing container with name, path, and log path.

methods.name: Destructor
methods.description: Cleans up container, stopping it if necessary and removing from administrator.

methods.name: Pid
methods.description: Retrieves the process ID of the running container.

methods.name: Memory
methods.description: Returns memory info of the container.

methods.name: ProcessorInfo
methods.description: Returns processor info of the container.

methods.name: NetworkInterfaces
methods.description: Returns network interfaces associated with the container (stubbed as nullptr).

methods.name: IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the container with specified command and parameters.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the container, optionally with a timeout.

methods.name: OverwriteContainerArgs
methods.description: Replaces the container's process arguments with new command and parameters.

methods.name: ClearLeftovers
methods.description: Removes leftover containers from previous runs.
